question: At Hogwarts, the Sorting Hat analyzes a new student's traits step-by-step using a set of rules to place them into Gryffindor, Hufflepuff, Ravenclaw, or Slytherin. In computer science, what is such a finite, step-by-step procedure called?
Sauron forged 'One Ring to rule them all', designed so that no other ring shares its unique power. In a relational database, what attribute uniquely identifies each record and prevents duplicates?

In Game of Thrones, the massive 700-foot ice Wall protects Westeros by inspecting everyone who arrives and blocking Wildlings or White Walkers based on strict rules. Which computer security system performs this exact traffic-filtering role?

Harry's Invisibility Cloak renders secret data invisible and unreadable to eavesdroppers while moving through Hogwarts. What computer technique scrambles plain text into unreadable ciphertext to protect data?

The Seeing Stones (Palantíri) in Middle-earth allow Gandalf and Saruman to communicate across distant realms. For devices on the global Internet to locate and route packets to one another, what logical address must each device have?

In Professor Dumbledore's Pensieve, he layers magical memory strands into a basin. When retrieving thoughts, the very last memory placed inside is the first one examined. Which data structure follows this Last-In, First-Out (LIFO) principle?

At Castle Black, recruits line up for their turn to take the Night's Watch oath. The first recruit who arrives in line is the first one sworn in. Which data structure follows this First-In, First-Out (FIFO) principle?

In the Dwarven libraries of Moria, records of mithril mines are sorted numerically by year. If Gimli searches by repeatedly dividing the sorted records in half to find a year, which algorithm is he using?

Wizards enter fireplace grates in the Floo Network and are routed to different magical households based on destination names. Which network device similarly routes data packets between different IP networks?

Geralt of Rivia searches his Monster Bestiary by looking up a monster's name (the key) to immediately retrieve its specific weaknesses (the value). Which computer data structure stores data as key-value pairs?

Maesters at the Citadel send ravens addressed to castles like 'Winterfell', and the birds find the exact physical castle location. Which Internet service translates human-friendly domain names (like www.google.com) into numerical IP addresses?

Just as the fiery heart of Mount Doom is where the Ring was forged and where the fate of Middle-earth is determined, which central hardware component executes all computer instructions and performs logical processing?

The Room of Requirement at Hogwarts transforms instantly to hold whatever a wizard needs, but when everyone leaves and the magic powers down, its contents vanish. Which volatile computer memory temporarily holds active programs and clears upon reboot?

Master Jocasta Nu declares that ancient core records in the Jedi Archives cannot be altered or overwritten by unauthorized visitors. Which non-volatile computer chip contains permanent startup instructions (BIOS/UEFI) that cannot be easily overwritten?
Valyrian steel daggers are the fastest, sharpest weapons closest to a combatant's hand. Which ultra-fast memory storage is located directly inside the CPU chip to provide near-instant data access?

Hermione uses a Time-Turner to revisit earlier points in time, creating a loop where a wizard interacts with a previous version of herself until a stopping condition is reached. In programming, what is a function that calls itself called?

Treebeard leads the Entmoot through a hierarchy branching out from root elders to limb branches and leaves. What non-linear computer data structure organizes data hierarchically starting from a 'root' node to 'leaf' nodes?

In Narnia, Lucy steps through the back of an ordinary wardrobe to leave the human world and enter the magical realm of Narnia. On a computer network, what is the router address that allows a local device to exit its LAN and reach outside networks?

When Barty Crouch Jr. drinks Polyjuice Potion, he disguises his appearance to impersonate Professor Mad-Eye Moody. In cybersecurity, what is it called when an attacker impersonates a trusted IP address or email identity to deceive targets?

Frodo and Sam journey across the wastes of Mordor communicating directly with one another without answering to any central king or master. Which network architecture connects two computers directly with equal privileges without a dedicated central server?

Doctor Strange casts spells into the Mirror Dimension—an isolated, simulated realm where real-world structures are mirrored without affecting the physical universe. What computing technology runs isolated simulated operating systems on top of real physical hardware?

Bran Stark as the Three-Eyed Raven doesn't physically walk to every castle; he merely 'points' his mind to specific coordinates in history. In languages like C and C++, what special variable stores the memory address of another variable?

The unforgivable curse Avada Kedavra instantly terminates an adversary's life without delay. In Unix and Linux operating systems, which command or signal immediately and forcibly terminates a running process?
Dwarven blacksmiths forge mithril ingots in clusters of 16. In computer science, which number system uses base 16 with digits 0–9 and letters A–F to represent large binary values compactly?
A Witcher sign is either cast or uncast, evaluating to one of only two possible states: active (True) or inactive (False). Which computer data type holds only two truth values: True or False?

The great houses of Westeros declare unchanging mottos: 'Winter is Coming' (Stark) and 'Hear Me Roar' (Lannister). What programming concept defines an identifier whose value cannot be reassigned or modified after creation?
Hermione casts a spell to rearrange hundreds of library spellbooks alphabetically from A to Z. What general class of algorithmic procedures arranges unordered data into a designated sequence?

The fiery Elvish script engraved on the One Ring translates ancient speech into visible characters. What worldwide standard encoding system assigns unique numeric code points to every letter, character, and symbol across all human and fantasy languages?

Aang must master four elements in order: [Water, Earth, Fire, Air]. In programming, what indexed data structure stores elements of the same type at contiguous, sequential memory locations accessible via indices like elements[0]?

The Marauder's Map tracks the unique, permanent physical identity of every person walking in Hogwarts regardless of where they roam. Which unique 48-bit physical hardware address is permanently burned into a device's network card?

Daenerys Targaryen commands Drogon, Rhaegal, and Viserion simultaneously to strike three different targets in parallel. What modern CPU architecture incorporates multiple independent processing units on a single chip to execute tasks concurrently?

Gollum and Smeagol argue in an endless circle: each personality refuses to yield until the other gives up the Ring first, causing both to freeze in total inaction. In operating systems, what is it called when two processes are permanently blocked because each holds a resource the other needs?

In the sprawling underground Labyrinth of Daedalus, passages twist and connect multiple chambers in complex interconnected webs. Which non-linear data structure of vertices (nodes) and edges represents such networks?

In Quidditch, the game proceeds normally until the Golden Snitch suddenly appears, immediately halting regular play so the Seeker can dive for it. In computer hardware, what is a hardware signal that temporarily halts the CPU's current execution to handle an urgent event?

When Geralt drinks too many potions, his toxicity meter exceeds its maximum allowable limit, causing sudden toxicity damage. What occurs in programming when an arithmetic calculation exceeds the maximum storage capacity of a fixed-size integer?

The Iron Bank of Braavos maintains strict ledgers: every financial transfer must be fully completed or entirely undone if interrupted, with zero partial transfers allowed. Which database property guarantees that a group of database operations either all succeed or all fail together?

The nine members of the Fellowship of the Ring travel together sharing the same quest and camp resources, but each can run and fight independently in parallel. In operating systems, what is a lightweight unit of execution within a shared process called?

Harry speaks human English, but snakes understand only the native serpent language of Parseltongue. What software program translates high-level human-readable programming language source code directly into native machine code (0s and 1s) for the CPU?

The Galactic Empire constructed the Death Star with a tiny, overlooked thermal exhaust port flaw that allows a single torpedo to destroy the whole station. In cybersecurity, what is an unintended flaw or weakness in software that can be exploited by attackers called?

Doctor Strange confronts Dormammu by declaring 'I've come to bargain', trapping both in an endless loop that repeats as long as the condition remains true without a break. In programming, what control structure repeats a block of code as long as a condition evaluates to True?

Wildfire is a dangerous green alchemical liquid that ignites, spreads uncontrollably, and destroys whatever castle it touches. What broad term refers to destructive computer programs like viruses, worms, and ransomware engineered to harm systems?

When Harry casts Expelliarmus against Voldemort's curse, he catches and disarms an unexpected fatal strike before it destroys him. Which programming construct is used to intercept and handle unexpected runtime errors gracefully without crashing the application?

Elf eyes have extraordinary visual acuity: Legolas can count distant Uruk-hai riders miles away across Rohan. On computer monitors, what metric measures the total number of distinct pixels displayed horizontally and vertically (e.g. 1920x1080)?

After the defeat of the White Witch, Aslan breathes upon stone statues to restore them, clearing away useless petrified clutter from Narnia. In memory-managed programming languages (like Java and Python), what automated background process reclaims memory allocated to objects no longer in use?

An Owl Post delivery requires the bird to physically return with a delivery confirmation receipt, whereas an instantaneous Patronus message flashes forward quickly without waiting for an acknowledgment. Which reliable transport protocol guarantees ordered, acknowledged packet delivery similar to the owl receipt?

The Faceless Men of Braavos disguise their internal identities behind masks, exposing only their public persona while keeping their true inner workings private. In Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), what principle bundles data and methods while hiding internal implementation details?

Sauron focuses his massive dark gaze on the Black Gate, overwhelming the defending army with a relentless swarm of hundreds of thousands of Orcs at once. In networking, what cyberattack floods a target server with bogus requests to exhaust its bandwidth and crash it?

The Mirror of Erised takes the deepest desire of your heart and stores it as a visible reflection. In programming, what operator (symbol) is used to assign a computed value to a named variable (e.g. score = 100)?

Geralt uses the magical Sign of Axii to charm gate guards into verifying his identity and opening city gates. In computer security, what process verifies that a user attempting to log in is truly who they claim to be (using passwords, tokens, or biometrics)?

Gimli's battle axe has two sharp sides—either it strikes (1) or it rests (0). At the most fundamental electronic level, what base-2 numeral system consisting solely of 0s and 1s do all modern digital computers use to compute and store data?
